name: formforge
description: Privacy-first open-source form backend for static sites on Cloudflare Workers and D1

AUTH_SECRET.description: Secret for authentication system. Use https://jwtsecrets.com or openssl rand -hex 32 to generate a secure secret (64 characters). No need to remember it.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Optional. API key from Resend.com to send transactional emails.

RESEND_FROM.description: Optional. Verified sender address for Resend notifications.

BREVO_API_KEY.description: Optional. API key from Brevo (Sendinblue) for transactional emails (300/day free).

SENDGRID_API_KEY.description: Optional. API key from SendGrid for transactional emails (100/day free).

MAILGUN_API_KEY.description: Optional. API key from Mailgun for transactional emails (5,000/month free).

ALLOW_REGISTRATION.description: Set to 'false' to disable new user registration (owner-only mode).

S3_ENDPOINT.description: Optional. S3-compatible endpoint URL (e.g. https://s3.us-west-002.backblazeb2.com). Works with Backblaze B2, Wasabi, Storj, MinIO, AWS S3, etc.
